CJI Surya Kant Refuses Meeting with INDIA Bloc Leaders

Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant declined a meeting request from leaders of the INDIA bloc. The leaders, including Rahul Gandhi and Mallikarjun Kharge, had sought the meeting to discuss alleged electoral irregularities. CJI Surya Kant advised the leaders to file a petition in court regarding their concerns. The refusal came amidst ongoing protests related to the Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) issue.
